Lime wash paint made of slaked lime and mineral pigments, with no synthetic resins or acrylic binders, is a candidate for a few headings. Heading 3208 covers paints based on synthetic polymers in a non-aqueous medium. Heading 3209 covers paints based on synthetic polymers in an aqueous medium. Heading 3210 covers other paints and varnishes, including water pigments for finishing leather. Heading 3214 covers glaziers' putty and similar mastics. Heading 3212 covers pigments dispersed in non-aqueous media.

Because this product has no synthetic polymer binder, it does not fit 3208 or 3209. Heading 3210 is the best fit, as "other paints and varnishes" covers distempers and lime-based paints. Subheading 3210.00.00 is split into 3210.00.0010 (Paints and varnishes, including enamels and lacquers) and 3210.00.0090 (other). I considered 3210.00.0010 for paints, but the 3210.00 subheadings are: 3210.00.00 with statistical suffixes 10 (Paints and varnishes (including enamels, lacquers and distempers)) and 90 (Other).

Since this is a powder paint (a distemper-type product), I chose 3210.00.0010.
